chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibn Mahbub from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf from Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) said:
My father (peace be upon him) said to one of his children: 'Beware of laziness and boredom, for these two prevent you from your share of the world and the Hereafter.'
ai.seo_question: What are the two traits that prevent a person from achieving success in this world and the next according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him) identifies laziness (al-kasal) and restlessness (al-dajara) as dual spiritual impediments that obstruct one's portion (hazz) in both dunya and akhirah. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on active engagement and balance, warning that these traits not only diminish worldly success but also hinder spiritual growth and the attainment of divine reward.
